text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the school store with
Daitaku Helios... the clerk's face was completely pale.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, ma'am?
You're totally down in the dumps, big sad vibes.

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Helios-chan...!
Th-The thing is... you see...!!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally ordered 100 times more fruit sandwiches
than usual, and they don't even keep for long—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You mean the ones always lined up right here?
Those times a hundred? Ahaha, that's insaneee!!"

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'll cut the price in half!
Please~! Everyone, please eat some~...!
choice_data_list: Wouldn't that put you in the red...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: What's up? Are you in serious trouble?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
As long as we sell a ton, it's all good, right?
All right, I'm gonna go hunt down some customers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if there are leftovers, it cannot be helped.
Please allow me to contribute to my heart's content...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to help as well.
Priority goes to consuming what we have; I will ask the others too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have that for lunch, then.
Not sure how much of a help it'll be, though."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Helping each other cleanses the spirit, and that keeps
moral discipline clean too! I'll help out, osu!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaddya think? It went down a whole bunch, didn't it!?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful, of course...
But there are still so many left...
choice_data_list: There's only so much we can do within the academy, huh...
Staying just inside the academy might have its limits...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Then let's open a second store! ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
HEY YO!! Come here-!!
Let's get hyped with some fruit sandwiches! ââ

text_block_list.name: Helios & Ines
text_block_list.text: Waaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Helios-chan, leave the selling to me!
I'll show off the skills I honed in the prepared foods section~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on going~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on☆ Everyone gather 'round, come closer~~...!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Helios~! I saw the video!
Are you seriously in a pinch!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Woooow! Tysm, love ya~~☆
Fr for real! That's insane!
choice_data_list: More and more people keep gathering...!?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sales are picking up pace!
Now... it's a race against time, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do the finishing touches!
Let's paaaartyyy~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: LIIIIIIIVE!!!
choice_data_list: Aren't you a little too light on your feet!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A makeshift stage is set up in no time.
And just as quickly, fans gather around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this... her current popularity?
Are these the fans she has drawn in?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyâ
Don't hold back! Get hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Let's move our bodies like crazy and work up an appetite~!
Then party with some fruit sandwiches!"

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
T-They sold...! We did it!
The fruit sandwiches are completely sold out!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay☆★
The live merch is insane! Congrats on selling out!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Helios! It was so great to see you!
Pull off something huge next time too!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I only came because they invited me,
but it was so much fun! I'm officially a fan!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Thaaanks☆★
All of humanity is my friend forever☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whoa...
Everyone's so incredible, it's making me tear up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's keep this momentum going
and hype it up even more at karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios, who turned so many heads
and accomplished a nearly impossible mission.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she dragged me toward karaoke, I found myself appreciating once again just how amazing she was.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Isn't there some left over...?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
In a corner like this... one, two... three of them.
I closed up shop without even noticing.
choice_data_list: I'll treat the three of us here.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no way!? For real!?
No waaaay! You're a godsend!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
All right! Thanks for the treat!
After-party, here we go☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios resolved the problem with the power of friendship and her fans. Once again, I was left in awe of her immense popularity...
